reasons.plausibility: It uses well-established concepts (configurational entropy, lattice distortion) with a credible mismatch threshold and aligns with known HEA theory.
reasons.testability: It specifies clear experimental comparisons (two mismatch regimes) and measurable outcomes (phase stability vs. segregation) to falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a concrete, direct study design that addresses a key stability question for high-temperature HEA nanoparticles, guiding composition and processing choices.
